name: Corsair K95 RGB Platinum XT
notes: 115-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Corsair K95 RGB Platinum XT, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/ckb-next/ckb-next/issues/543#issuecomment-766288994. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
